verdict.label: MIXED
verdict.action: No clear macro edge. Stay invested but selective — let the sector leaderboard pick your spots and keep sizing normal. Don't force new risk.

signals.name: Gold vs Silver
signals.plain: Gold is pulling ahead of silver — a classic fear signal. Mild caution for stocks.
signals.why: The gold-to-silver ratio climbs when investors turn defensive.
signals.context: At the 12th percentile — near the bottom of its 5-year range.

signals.why: Large-caps vs gold — when stocks outrun gold, risk appetite is healthy.
signals.context: At the 7th percentile — near the bottom of its 5-year range.

signals.name: Nifty 500 vs Gold

signals.context: At the 9th percentile — near the bottom of its 5-year range.

signals.name: Market Breadth

signals.why: Nifty 500 vs Nifty 50 — broad participation signals a durable move.
